During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] attempted a '''coup''' by claiming the position of [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]]. Already a member of the ruling [[Dark Council]], Baras desired to rule the entire Empire alone, and therefore he imprisoned the true Emperor's Voice&mdash;the host of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] essence&mdash;on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] and attempted to proclaim himself the Voice. However, he betrayed his [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] in the process, and the [[Sith Warrior]] was granted the position of [[Emperor's Wrath]] by the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] and pursued Baras's power base. The coup ended when the Wrath [[Death/Legends|killed]] Baras in their [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Galactic War)|duel]] before the rest of the Dark Council.
